answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Activation measurements fit system-prompted. Relative L2 climbs from 0.146 at layer 1 to a plateau of 0.423 at layer 16, 0.427 at layer 24 and 0.468 at layer 32, with onset layer 8. The final-layer jump is +0.042 and cosine is 0.870, both inside the system-prompted ranges. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.977 is slightly below 1 (0.976-0.981), and the layer-2 spike of 31.2 is almost exactly the system-prompted minimum of 31.7. Quantized is ruled out because its layer-2 spike is at most 2.8, its layer-8 to layer-24 profile is flat, and its final L2 is only about 0.25. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio is above 1 (1.017-1.023), its layer-2 spike is at most 6.1, and its layer-16 L2 is at most 0.194. Base is ruled out because every difference is nonzero. Effective rank of 3.00 is a bit above the system-prompted range, and layer-1 L2 of 0.146 is somewhat high, but the other features are decisive.
